**Rendering Verdict:**
All UI elements render correctly with no clipping, overflow, or misalignment. Text is fully readable including all CJK characters. The layout is clean with proper spacing. Navigation sidebar is fully functional and visible. All interactive elements (buttons, search, dropdown) are prominent and clickable. The authenticated state is correctly displayed with user name and verification alert. No loading spinners or error states present. Content grid is properly aligned in a 3-column layout. All brand cards display complete information without truncation.
